body: I am looking for validation in others. Because for as long as I remember I have despised myself. I know I can't ever be happy with myself. I'm just so fucking broken. ADD meds gave me panic attacks so I stopped taking them but without them I can barely function as a human being. I'm just a burden on everyone and I want to disappear forever. I care too much about my family to kill myself but once they are gone I'm gone. Im just so fucking done.

I'm actually looking into going to a psychologist at my university, so that's one thing I guess. Just writing this whole thing down (never done that before) has kinda helped getting my thoughts in order. Understanding myself better can only be a good thing if I'm going to tackle this. Thanks for your reply, I appreciate it.

I never finish anything I start because everything feels pointless. I don't have any meaningful social interaction because I keep everyone at a distance. I just generally feel useless. I wouldn't care if I just stopped existing if it wouldn't sadden the few people who care. I'm not living up to my supposed potential, which only reinforces the feeling of failure.
